comment: The maker's tooltip for output 2 reads X-B, the same as output 1; the panel prints A, B, C, D across the row, so output 2 is the C column. The line describes the jack without naming its letter. The four lamps over the MODE button show which of the eight models is selected and are not parameters. The menu item is printed MODE here and Model on the full-size Caudal in VultModulesFree — not a mistake in either entry: the Compacts build has no Model wording at all, while the full-size one carries it beside the Pendula, Planets and Fish Tank choices. Do not reconcile the two.
